name: wanderlust-frontend
description: React Native (Expo) client for the Wanderlust tourism recommender.
_comment_scripts: The Expo CLI is invoked through node with a relative path rather than as the bare `expo` command. The bare form resolves via node_modules/.bin, whose shim breaks when the project path contains characters a shell treats as syntax (an '&' in a parent folder name splits the PATH in CMD, and the .ps1 shim is blocked by PowerShell execution policy). Calling node directly avoids the shim entirely and works on any path.
